page.overview:
What is Springtrap Cosplay?

The Springtrap Cosplay in the Tales from the Pizzaplex series is a suit worn by Luca in Pressure, the second story of Tales from the Pizzaplex 3: Somniphobia.

The Springtrap Cosplay is a ratty-looking, puke-yellow-green rabbit suit with matted, putrid fur that feels crusty and scummy. Its old with reddish splotches, torn ears, and patches of fur ripped away, exposing the suit’s substructure in several places. The suit is big and baggy, and it comes in two pieces. The first is its big, ghoul-eyed, toothy-mouthed head. The head has exposed yellowish teeth, and its mouth is described as a “grim maw of desolation.” A wire sticks out from its jaw, more protrude from a hole in the fur on its head, and even more extend from beneath its dark eye sockets. The other part of the suit is its body, with hidden closures up the front allowing people to step into it. The covering of the suit’s big, fuzzy, skeletal-looking hands is missing a good chunk of fur, exposing metal on numerous fingers. It also has oversized feet which shoes can fit into.

The Springtrap suit is big and baggy, and both its fur and the metal skeleton beneath it stretch to accommodate people's heights. There’s a mechanism on the back of the suit’s head that keeps it locked on.

Springtrap appears in the beginning of Pressure as an old suit that Luca is made to wear to act in his and his friends' roleplaying game at the Urban Legends Role Play Auditorium in Freddy Fazbear's Mega Pizzaplex.
